title: Workspace picker · round 1
intro: Claude Design, 23 Nov. iPhone first, iPad where it differs. Three directions for the workspace capsule's list. Each is drawn with 1 Mac and with 3 Macs × 10 workspaces with one Mac offline, long names, dark (B and C also in light).

A · Refined system Menu (cost S): stay a system Menu, but give it a shape: Mac Details and Pair a Mac in a fixed top row, other Macs folded into submenus, one status line per workspace. The row glyph shows the status (hand = waiting, ✕ = failed, play = running, folder = idle). It cannot show a Mac colour, amber or dimming; with 10 workspaces it scrolls and the current one can be below the fold.
B · Mac cards sheet (cost L): one card per Mac with its colour, state, workspaces and Mac Details; quiet workspaces fold behind "Show all 10 workspaces"; search above 8 workspaces in all.

C · Mac strip sheet (cost M, designer's pick): one Mac at a time: a strip of Macs on top (colour dot, hollow when offline, amber count only when something waits), that Mac's whole list below. Same shape as the iPad sidebar. Trade-off: a wait on another Mac shows only as a count on its chip.

Rows in B and C: the 28-pt status circle from the session rows: amber hand = needs you, red ✕ = failed, grey play = running, grey folder = idle with the last-active time, accent checkmark = current. An offline Mac keeps its colour; its rows show at 55% with "as of 09:12".

Plugin fields: all three need one NEW field per workspace in the workspace list: activity {needsYou, running, failed, lastActiveAt}; the Go plugin decides what counts as running or failed, and the picker does not load 30 session lists. Optional NEW mac.model (desktop or laptop glyph) for A and B. "as of 09:12" is the phone's own last-received time, no field.
